# Karnataka Tourism

> > Official tourism portal for Karnataka, India, showcasing UNESCO World Heritage Sites, cultural destinations, and travel experiences across regions including Hampi, Mysuru, Chikmagalur, and Gokarna.

Karnataka Tourism is the official government portal promoting tourism in Karnataka state, featuring heritage sites from the Vijayanagara Empire, diverse travel destinations across districts like Ballari and Kalyana Karnataka Region, and comprehensive event information for travelers and tourists.

## Key Topics

- Karnataka
- Hampi
- UNESCO World Heritage Sites
- Vijayanagara Empire
- Mysuru
- Chikmagalur
- Gokarna
- Kalyana Karnataka Region
- Ballari District
- Vijaynagar District
- Heritage Sites
- Travel Destinations
- Tourism Events
- Government of Karnataka

## Getting Started

- [Karnataka Tourism Homepage](https://web-cms.karnatakatourism.org/): Homepage for Karnataka Tourism featuring heritage sites and destinations

## Events & Planning

- [Event Calendar](https://karnatakatourism.org/en/event-calendar): Tourism events calendar with newsletter subscription options
